findings.issue: No test script, no test runner, and zero test files anywhere in app/; the app's behavior is guarded only by the harness-owned acceptance suite
findings.suggestion: Add vitest (zero-config with the existing vite setup) plus a `test` script, and start with unit tests for lib/format.ts and lib/data.ts pure functions

findings.issue: cardsForPokemonRefs — the pokemon-ref→species mapping, id>10000 exclusion, dedupe and dex sort — is the app's central transformation and is untested; the hiddenById last-wins overwrite at app/src/lib/data.ts:417 could silently flip 'Hidden ability' flags
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a fixture containing deoxys-normal (386), an alt form (10001), a duplicate ref and a hidden/non-hidden pair, asserting the emitted CardVM list

findings.issue: URL-state and filtering logic untested: validateSearch page sanitization, humanized-name substring match, either-slot type match, page clamping to totalPages, and filter-change resetting page
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/paginate step into a pure function and test it (empty q, whitespace, page=0/NaN, page beyond total, no matches)

findings.issue: sortRows' missing-values-last-in-both-directions rule and mixed number/string comparison are classic off-by-a-comparator territory; aria-sort wiring is also untested
findings.suggestion: Unit-test sortRows with nulls mixed into every column and both directions, plus a small render test asserting aria-sort on exactly the active header

findings.issue: Moves derivation untested: selected-game default (games[games.length-1]), METHOD_ORDER-with-alphabetical-fallback comparator, and level-up level-then-name ordering
findings.suggestion: Fixture a pokemon.moves payload with two version groups and mixed methods, assert game list order, default selection and table/row order

findings.issue: Only 404 maps to notFound(); any other API failure rethrows with no errorComponent registered (app/src/routes/__root.tsx:14-19), so a 500 renders the framework default — an untested, unstyled path
findings.suggestion: Add a root errorComponent and a test for the ApiError-500 path (can be a unit test of withNotFound plus a render test)

findings.issue: latestEnglishFlavorText (last-en entry, \n/\f whitespace collapsing) and humanize/dexNumber edge cases are untested despite being spec-critical and trivial to test
findings.suggestion: A handful of pure-function unit tests with real API strings (e.g. flavor text containing \f)

findings.issue: The in-memory promise cache's delete-on-failure and the module-level cache resets in data.ts (26-76) are untested; a refactor could cache rejected promises and make transient API errors sticky
findings.suggestion: Unit-test that a failed fetch is retried on the next call and that a success is served from cache

summary: The app ships no tests of its own — no runner, no script, no files — so every dimension of test quality rests on the external acceptance suite. That's unfortunate because the codebase is unusually testable: format.ts and most of data.ts are pure functions covering the app's riskiest logic (ref→species mapping, filtering, pagination, sorting). Once the acceptance suite stops being the gate, a data-layer refactor could break card lists, move tables or pagination silently.
